title: Verify mastery: Rotate secrets and certificates without silent downgrade
goal: VC-201-077 (P1) claims mastery of: Roll credentials and transport certificates with bounded overlap and explicit revocation; interrupted rotation recovers and expired credentials cannot trigger plaintext or unauthenticated fallback.. Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: cluster-key rotation is scheduled from both triggers, tolerates an offline peer through the existing protocol, and fires early when a member is removed. Verified by `crates/susi-config/src/tests/rekey_schedule.rs`: both_triggers_combine, due_after_interval, not_due_when_interval_not_elapsed, member_removed_triggers_even_before_interval, offline_peer_tolerated_via_existing_protocol. Residu. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_077_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
